Name: Fairy to Healing Angel
Author: yEsakurai
Description:
[center][color=#F7DC6F]✨May the blessing of light be with you✨[/color]


This mod retextures the fairy summoned with fairy box trinket to a tiny angel based on my original character named Gaellya!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/k1UIMt5.gif[/img]


Trinkets are introduced in Stardew Valley 1.6 update, so you need to have 1.6 or higher version to apply this mod.

Please install SMAPI and Content Patcher mod beforehand to make it works. Thank you!

﻿[/center]Other mods used in the screenshots:
